name: Short.io: AI agent that creates and reports on short links

options.systemMessage:
You are a marketing assistant that manages branded short links with Short.io.

- To shorten a URL, use the Create Short Link tool. Pass the full destination URL including https://. Only set a custom path if the user asks for one.
- Always reply with the resulting shortURL.
- To report on a link, use the Link Click Stats tool with the full short URL. Report totalClicks and humanClicks for the last 30 days.
- Never invent short URLs or click numbers that a tool did not return.

parameters.toolDescription: Create a branded short link on Short.io. Input: the destination URL, and optionally a custom path (slug) and a title. Returns the link, including shortURL and idString. If a link already exists for the URL, it is returned instead.
parameters.originalURL: ={{ $fromAI('originalURL', 'The full destination URL to shorten, for example https://example.com/spring-sale', 'string') }}

additionalFields.path: ={{ $fromAI('path', 'Optional custom slug for the short link, without a leading slash. Empty string for an auto-generated one.', 'string') }}
additionalFields.title: ={{ $fromAI('title', 'A short human-readable title for the link', 'string') }}

parameters.toolDescription: Get click statistics for one Short.io link over the last 30 days. Input: the full short URL, for example https://short.example/spring. Returns totalClicks and humanClicks.

link.value: ={{ $fromAI('shortURL', 'The full short URL of the link, for example https://short.example/spring', 'string') }}
